bibl.title: Caracalla’s Titulature, Geta’s Murder, and Egypt. Some Chronological Considerations
bibl.seg: Nikolaos Gonis, Caracalla's Titulature, Geta's Murder, and Egypt. Some Chronological Considerations.
bibl.note: Examines how the assumption by Caracalla of the victory title Parthicus maximus and of his father's surname Severus are reflected in papyri from Egypt.
